description: Reveal work emails for people on a DealMap, by node_id from get_dealmap (up to 10 people per call). Send email calls one at a time: wait for each response before sending the next, never in parallel (parallel calls compete for the same lookup capacity, so most people come back pending and have to be asked for again). Always call with dry_run: true first: it returns an estimate and what each person would cost, with no address and no charge. A real call needs max_credits (the most you allow) and charges 1 credit per address actually delivered; an address already unlocked or supplied by the team is free, and a person whose address cannot be shared returns email_status do_not_contact with no address and no charge. Each result has email_status: revealed, already_unlocked, team_supplied, do_not_contact, not_found, undeliverable, pending (still looking, not a no-result: ask again after retry_after_seconds, free, and the answer may be ready by then), unavailable, insufficient_credits or denied. Use a new UUID idempotency_key for each fresh attempt. Reuse a key only when your call produced no response at all (client timeout or network error): the earlier result is returned and nothing is charged twice (a call can take up to about 80 seconds, so give it time first). After a 409 use a new key; after a 503 or 504 also wait the Retry-After seconds first. Addresses already delivered come back as already_unlocked at no charge. A 403 with code email_reveal_not_enabled means the workspace does not have email reveal yet; tell the user briefly and do not retry. Requires "read" and "outreach" scopes.

dry_run.description: Estimate only: no address is returned and nothing is charged. Recommended first call.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID you generate for each fresh attempt. Reuse it only when your call got no response at all (timeout or network error): the earlier result is returned with no second charge. After a 409 use a new one; after a 503/504 wait Retry-After first, then use a new one.

max_credits.description: Required unless dry_run: the most credits you allow this call to charge. The call stops with 422 before charging if the estimate is higher.

node_ids.description: node_id values of people from get_dealmap, up to 10

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: get_dealmap_emails
